market.label: Positive, stretched
market.headline: Nifty reclaims 25,000 (+0.23% to 25,044.65); Bank Nifty +1.51% to 59,741.25
market.text: On 9 Nov Nifty closed at 25,044.65 (+0.23%) and Sensex at 81,106.65 (+0.13%), an eight-month closing high, while Bank Nifty rose 1.51% to 59,741.25 as the PSU Bank index gained about 3.7%. IT was the weakest sector (Nifty IT about −1.2%). India VIX fell about 5.5% to 17.42. Breadth was negative (1,922 advances vs 2,316 declines). Markets are shut on Tue 10 Nov (Diwali Balipratipada); India October CPI is due Thu 12 Nov. 9 Nov FII/DII cash figures were not yet published in the sources checked.

analyst.label: Mixed to mildly positive
analyst.text: Bharti Airtel drew a round of post-Q2 revisions on 9 Nov (Business Today): Morgan Stanley cut its target to ₹2,350 and Jefferies to ₹2,380 (Buy), JPMorgan raised to ₹2,290 (Overweight), ICICI Securities raised to ₹2,430, Motilal Oswal at ₹2,395 and Emkay Reduce at ₹2,000. No other confirmed large-cap rating changes were found for 9 Nov; other stocks keep their earlier dated notes.

institutional.label: Aggregate buying, stock data thin
institutional.text: Latest confirmed exchange data: FPIs net bought ₹13,749.82 cr and DIIs net sold ₹5,968.70 cr on 6 Nov (provisional); FPIs reportedly bought over $4.1 bn of Indian equities so far in November. 9 Nov figures were not yet available. No new stock-level bulk/block deals or promoter/MF disclosures were confirmed for the tracked names this run; disclosures shown are delayed filings with their filing dates.

retail.label: No fresh reading
retail.text: No new published retail sentiment surveys or reported investor-chatter pieces were found for 9 Nov. Retail scores carry over from earlier dated items. This module has no live social feed; mood comes only from public coverage.

reliability.label: Too few results yet
reliability.text: Model v0.1-qualitative is uncalibrated. Today 16 due predictions were checked against 9 Nov closes; 13 still await a confirmed 9 Nov close and will be retried. Cumulative checked: 120. Treat outlooks as research context only.
